method: One 5-item warm-up, three independent raw engines each at 10/100/500 items, one compiled profile per process, exact installed Wasm package; no editor DOM/browser owner. Raw commands pass false for history-group closure and do not call projectionUpdate() on returned results. Timed projection is handle acquisition only. Checks/returned-handle inspection and disposal are outside timed calls, except JSON helpers include takeValue/disposal. Timer-rounded zero is not zero work. Not directly subtractable from browser-owner timings.
assertions: 14 unique entries with no faults or absent identity/status
snapshot revision and lineage match exact current observation
exact-hit contents match and changedCount is zero
action-state reads preserve document, selection and pending formats
inserted text and complete document match an independent expected edit
exact undo, V6 backup/reopen and redo
